notes: item search (ST_ITEM_SEARCH.fmx, a query screen): search criterion (item name / item code / group code) and search type (contains / starts with / ends with / equals), optional group (items under the group's code prefix); per item its basic unit and retail price, and per store (stores with movements) the store balance and store sales (non-deleted documents, EFFECT <> 7), the total quantity in all stores and the item location

proc.description_a: شاشة البحث عن صنف: اختر محدد البحث (اسم الصنف أو رقم الصنف أو رقم المجموعة) وطريقة البحث (يحتوي على، يبدأ بـ، ينتهي بـ، يساوى) واكتب قيمة البحث، ويمكن تحديد مجموعة، ثم اضغط بحث. يظهر لكل صنف وحدته الأساسية وسعر البيع ورصيد ومبيعات كل مخزن والكمية في المخازن كلها وموقع الصنف.
proc.description_e: Item search: choose the criterion (item name, item code or group code) and the search type (contains, starts with, ends with, equals), type the value, optionally choose a group, then press Search. Each item shows its basic unit and selling price, the balance and sales per store, the quantity in all stores and its location.

params.name: SEARCH_CRITERIA
params.lov_sql: select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', 'Item name', 'اسم الصنف') d, 1 r from dual union all select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', 'Item code', 'رقم الصنف'), 2 from dual union all select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', 'Group code', 'رقم المجموعة'), 3 from dual

params.name: SEARCH_TYPE
params.lov_sql: select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', 'Contains', 'يحتوي على') d, 1 r from dual union all select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', 'Starts with', 'يبدأ بـ'), 2 from dual union all select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', 'Ends with', 'ينتهي بـ'), 3 from dual union all select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', 'Equals', 'يساوى'), 4 from dual

params.name: GROUP_CODE
params.lov_sql: select g.item_group_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(g.name_e, g.name_a), g.name_a) d, g.item_group_code r from st_item_group g where nvl(g.stop_flag, 0) <> 1 order by g.item_group_code

proc.preview_sql: with bal as (select m.store_code, d.group_code, d.item_code, nvl(sum(decode(t.effect, 1, 1, 2, -1, 3, -1, 4, 1, 5, -1, 6, 1) * nvl(d.basic_qty, 0)), 0) bal, nvl(sum(decode(t.trns_type, 2, 1, 0) * nvl(d.basic_qty, 0)), 0) store_sales from st_trns_det d, st_trns_mast m, st_trns_type t where nvl(m.delete_flag, 0) = 0 and m.trns_type_code = t.trns_type_code and d.trns_type_code = m.trns_type_code and d.trns_serial = m.trns_serial and t.effect <> 7 group by m.store_code, d.group_code, d.item_code), it as (select i.* from st_item i where app_rules3_st.item_search_match(i.item_group_code, i.item_code, i.name_a, i.name_e, v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_SEARCH_TEXT'), to_number(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_SEARCH_CRITERIA')), to_number(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_SEARCH_TYPE')), to_number(v('P' || :APP_PAGE_ID || '_GROUP_CODE'))) = 1) select it.item_group_code, (select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(g.name_e, g.name_a), g.name_a) from st_item_group g where g.item_group_code = it.item_group_code) group_name, it.item_code, it.name_a, it.name_e, it.stop_flag, it.stop_reason, (select max(decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(u.name_e, u.name_a), u.name_a)) from st_item_unit iu, st_unit u where iu.group_code = it.item_group_code and iu.item_code = it.item_code and iu.basic_unit = 1 and u.unit_code = iu.unit_code) unit_name, (select max(iu.retail_sale_price) from st_item_unit iu where iu.group_code = it.item_group_code and iu.item_code = it.item_code and iu.basic_unit = 1) sales_price, b.store_code, (select decode(:G_LANG, 'en', nvl(s.name_e, s.name_a), s.name_a) from st_store s where s.store_code = b.store_code) store_name, b.bal store_bal, b.store_sales, sum(b.bal) over (partition by it.item_group_code, it.item_code) total_balance, (select min(a.location_label) from st_item_store_locations a, st_store_locations l where a.store_code = b.store_code and a.group_code = it.item_group_code and a.item_code = it.item_code and l.location_label = a.location_label) location_label from it left join bal b on b.group_code = it.item_group_code and b.item_code = it.item_code order by it.item_group_code, it.item_code, b.store_code
